qualification: Authoring source and comparator checks only; independent scholarly review and reader testing have not occurred.
source_reading: Every selected original verse and its notes read before independent composition.
findings: Read all 767 original records and their written/read and other annotations before independently drafting 766 public verses; read all 766 TSW comparators afterward. Focused authoring reread covered 225 public verses.

Preserved the names, genealogy sequences, explicitly named women and family ambiguities. Retained Vashni at public 6:28 with the possible firstborn/Joel reading in a note; Geba at 6:60 corrects the comparator’s Gibeah. The count of five in 7:3 remains beside four named sons.

Kept the different Jehoaddah/Jarah, Raphah/Rephaiah and other parallel-list forms rather than silently harmonizing them. The written/read name in 27:29 is represented by Shirtai, with its written form explained.

Preserved Saul’s suicide and the narrator’s attribution of his death to the LORD as distinct statements. Kept the terebinth at Jabesh, barley at Pas-dammim, Chidon, Huram, Beeliada, and the other readings particular to Chronicles.

Retained Amasai’s Spirit-clothing image and threefold peace in 12:18. His pledge and all the thanksgiving poetry in 16:8–36 remain lineated inside their verse paragraphs, including the narrative response in 16:36.

Kept the house/dynasty recurrence, my house and my kingdom at 17:14, the difficult elevated-humanity wording at 17:17, and the conditional language in David’s instructions. Notes identify consequential alternatives without treating an interpretation as settled.

Preserved the humiliation of the envoys, the violent verb in 20:3 with the forced-labor alternative noted, Lahmi as Goliath’s brother, and David’s bloodshed as the stated bar to his building the temple. Did not soften or harmonize the harm.

Checked military numbers, the 1,100,000/470,000 census, three years/months/days, seventy thousand deaths, six hundred gold shekels, and the very large temple-preparation amounts. Retained the two different Levite age thresholds in chapter 23.

Kept the lists of priestly and musical divisions in sequence. Jeriah is not made the father of the following three names at 24:23; the shorter first lot at 25:9 is not expanded. The six-son count in 25:3 remains beside five written names. All twenty-four musical lots remain present.

Preserved the repeated twenty-four-thousand monthly divisions, the varying name forms in the music rosters, the doorkeeper totals, the later daric coin name, and the second anointing of Solomon. Notes preserve the source’s chronological and numerical tensions.

Public 6:1–15 binds original 5:27–41; public 6:16–81 binds original 6:1–66. Public 12:4 includes both original 12:4 and 12:5; public 12:5–40 binds original 12:6–41. Across the cumulative book, all 943 original records are bound exactly once.

Reviewed all 117 high-overlap verses after the complete comparator reading. Many are short name chains, concise formulas or meaningful repeated biblical phrases. No minimum-change quota; shared clear wording was retained.
overlap_qualification: NFKC/casefold whole-verse word overlap is triage, not proof of fidelity, originality, legal uniqueness or comprehension. No change quota.
companion_impact: Changed wording invalidates earlier quote/text bindings for these chapters; reconcile during later Companion installation. No Companion files changed.
remaining_work: Whole-book Samuel, Kings and 1 Chronicles authoring consistency passes remain queued; independent editorial review and reader testing remain pending.
